choices.A: दोनों विधियों और केवल ‘सुरक्षा’ के अधीन कार्रवाई को, क्योंकि उल्लेख की शर्त विधि के बजाय कार्रवाई पर लागू होती है।
choices.B: केवल ‘सुरक्षा’ विधि और उसके अधीन की गई कार्रवाई को; अन्य विधि तथा स्वतंत्र कार्रवाई को यह छूट नहीं मिलती।
choices.C: दोनों विधियों को, लेकिन किसी कार्यपालिका कार्रवाई को नहीं, क्योंकि विशेष छूट केवल विधि बनाने के लिए है।
choices.D: दोनों विधियों और दोनों कार्रवाइयों को, क्योंकि आदेश के प्रवर्तन में रहते हुए आपात-संबंधी उल्लेख आवश्यक नहीं रहता।

question: भारत के संविधान के 1 मई 2024 के संग्रहित हिंदी पाठ के अनुसार, एक वैध राष्ट्रपति आदेश केवल अनुच्छेद 14 के प्रवर्तन का उल्लेख करता है। उसके दौरान बनी अन्यथा सक्षम विधि में वर्तमान आपात उद्घोषणा से संबंध का उल्लेख भी है। उस विधि को अनुच्छेद 19 के आधार पर चुनौती दी गई है; आदेश में अनुच्छेद 19 का उल्लेख नहीं है। सरकार केवल अनुच्छेद 359 के आधार पर चुनौती रोकना और अनुच्छेद 19 की सीमा हटना चाहती है। सही निष्कर्ष क्या है?

choices.A: अनुच्छेद 19 की चुनौती चल सकती है, लेकिन विधि बनाते समय उसकी सीमा केवल आपात-संबंधी उल्लेख से हट गई थी।
choices.B: विधि में आपात-संबंधी उल्लेख होने से भाग 3 के सभी अधिकारों की सीमाएं और उनके न्यायालयी प्रवर्तन हट जाते हैं।
choices.C: इस आदेश से अनुच्छेद 19 का न्यायालयी प्रवर्तन निलंबित नहीं होता और विशेष छूट उसकी सीमा भी नहीं हटाती।
choices.D: अनुच्छेद 19 की सीमा बनी रहती है, लेकिन भाग 3 की हर लंबित और नई न्यायालयी चुनौती आदेश से निलंबित हो जाती है।

question: भारत के संविधान के आधिकारिक 2024 संग्रहित हिंदी संस्करण के अनुसार, राज्यपाल ने सोमवार को अपने राज्य में मुख्य स्थान वाले उच्च न्यायालय की कार्यवाहियों में हिंदी अधिकृत करने का आदेश दिया, जबकि राष्ट्रपति की सहमति मंगलवार को मिली। अब भविष्य की कार्यवाहियों के लिए ऐसा प्राधिकरण चाहिए जिसमें अनुच्छेद 348(2) की ‘पूर्व सहमति’ वाली शर्त निर्विवाद रूप से पूरी हो। अन्य सभी शर्तें पूरी हैं। कौन-सा परिवर्तन यह उद्देश्य पूरा करेगा?

choices.A: सोमवार के आदेश को उच्च न्यायालय का मुख्य न्यायाधीश अनुमोदित करे और राष्ट्रपति की पूर्व सहमति की जगह वह अनुमोदन रखा जाए।
choices.B: सोमवार के आदेश को विधानसभा संकल्प से अनुमोदित किया जाए और राष्ट्रपति की पूर्व सहमति की जगह वह संकल्प रखा जाए।
choices.C: मंगलवार की सहमति प्राप्त होने के बाद राज्यपाल भविष्य की कार्यवाहियों के लिए नया प्राधिकरण-आदेश जारी करे।
choices.D: सोमवार का आदेश ही रखा जाए और केवल यह जोड़ा जाए कि राष्ट्रपति को उसकी सूचना उसी दिन भेजी गई थी।

question: भारत के संविधान के 1 मई 2024 को यथाविद्यमान संग्रहित हिंदी संस्करण के अनुसार, अनुमोदित आपात उद्घोषणा की चालू अवधि समाप्त होने से चालीस दिन पहले राज्य सभा और तीस दिन पहले लोक सभा ने अपेक्षित बहुमत से उसे प्रवृत्त बनाए रखने के संकल्प पारित कर दिए। कोई विघटन या वापसी नहीं हुई। अगली छह-मास अवधि की गणना के बारे में कौन-सा निष्कर्ष सही है?

choices.A: वह तभी चलेगी जब चालू अवधि के अंतिम दिन दोनों सदन फिर संकल्प पारित करें; पहले किए संकल्प केवल आशय व्यक्त करते हैं।
choices.B: वह राज्य सभा के पहले निरंतरता-संकल्प से चलेगी; बाद में लोक सभा की सहमति उसी आरंभिक तारीख की पुष्टि करेगी।
choices.C: वह लोक सभा के दूसरे निरंतरता-संकल्प से चलेगी; इसलिए चालू अवधि के शेष तीस दिन नई अवधि में समा जाएंगे।
choices.D: वह उस तारीख से चलेगी जिस पर उद्घोषणा अन्यथा प्रवर्तन में नहीं रहती; पहले किए संकल्प चालू अवधि के शेष दिन नहीं काटते।

question: भारत के संविधान के 1 मई 2024 को यथाविद्यमान हिंदी पाठ के अनुसार, राज्य लोक सेवा आयोग के एक सदस्य के संबंध में अनुच्छेद 317(1) के अधीन उच्चतम न्यायालय को निर्देश किया गया है। जांच की प्रक्रिया के नियम उच्चतम न्यायालय ने राष्ट्रपति के अनुमोदन से बनाए हैं और वे संसदीय विधि के अनुरूप हैं। राज्यपाल ने सदस्य को निलंबित किया। न्यायालय का प्रतिवेदन राष्ट्रपति को मिल चुका है, पर राष्ट्रपति ने अभी आदेश नहीं दिया है। कौन-सा निष्कर्ष सही है?

choices.A: जांच के नियम उच्चतम न्यायालय बना सकता है और निलंबन राष्ट्रपति का आदेश आने तक जारी रह सकता है।
choices.B: जांच के नियम उच्चतम न्यायालय बना सकता है, पर राज्य आयोग के सदस्य को केवल राष्ट्रपति निलंबित कर सकता है।
choices.C: जांच के नियम राष्ट्रपति अकेले बनाएगा और निलंबन न्यायालय का प्रतिवेदन तैयार होते ही समाप्त होगा।
choices.D: जांच के नियम राज्यपाल बनाएगा और प्रतिवेदन मिलने पर सदस्य का निलंबन अपने-आप समाप्त होगा।

question: भारत के संविधान के 1 मई 2024 को यथाविद्यमान हिंदी पाठ के अनुसार, उच्चतम न्यायालय की तीन न्यायाधीशों की पीठ इस अध्याय के अधीन ऐसी अपील सुन रही है जो अनुच्छेद 132 के अधीन नहीं है। सुनवाई के दौरान पीठ संतुष्ट होती है कि संविधान के निर्वचन का एक सारवान् विधिक प्रश्न अपील के निपटारे के लिए आवश्यक है। आगे की सही प्रक्रिया कौन-सी है?

choices.A: प्रश्न कम-से-कम पांच न्यायाधीशों की पीठ को राय के लिए भेजा जाए और राय मिलने पर अपील उसके अनुरूप निपटाई जाए।
choices.B: तीन न्यायाधीश प्रश्न स्वयं तय कर सकते हैं, यदि वे सर्वसम्मत हों और अपना निर्णय खुले न्यायालय में सुनाएं।
choices.C: तीन न्यायाधीश पहले अपील निपटाएं और उसके बाद संवैधानिक प्रश्न पांच न्यायाधीशों को सलाह के लिए भेजें।
choices.D: पूरी अपील कम-से-कम पांच न्यायाधीशों को अंतिम निपटारे के लिए भेजना अनिवार्य है और मूल पीठ की भूमिका समाप्त होगी।

question: भारत के संविधान के 1 मई 2024 को यथाविद्यमान हिंदी संस्करण के अनुसार, राज्य लोक सेवा आयोग का अध्यक्ष दिवालिया न्यायनिर्णीत हो गया है। सक्षम प्राधिकारी उसे इस आधार पर आदेश द्वारा हटाना चाहता है। हटाने से पद रिक्त होने पर नियमित उत्तराधिकारी के कार्यभार ग्रहण करने तक आयोग के किसी अन्य सदस्य से अध्यक्ष के कर्तव्य करवाने हैं। इन दो कदमों के लिए प्राधिकार का सही क्रम कौन-सा है?

choices.A: राष्ट्रपति दिवालियापन के आधार पर हटाने का आदेश कर सकते हैं; राज्य आयोग में अंतरिम कर्तव्यपालन करने वाला सदस्य भी राष्ट्रपति ही नियुक्त करेंगे।
choices.B: राष्ट्रपति दिवालियापन के आधार पर हटाने का आदेश कर सकते हैं; रिक्ति होने पर राज्यपाल आयोग के अन्य सदस्य को अंतरिम कर्तव्यपालन के लिए नियुक्त करेंगे।
choices.C: राज्यपाल दिवालियापन के आधार पर हटाने का आदेश कर सकते हैं; रिक्ति होने पर वही आयोग के अन्य सदस्य को अंतरिम कर्तव्यपालन के लिए नियुक्त करेंगे।
choices.D: राज्यपाल दिवालियापन के आधार पर हटाने का आदेश कर सकते हैं; उसके बाद राष्ट्रपति आयोग के अन्य सदस्य को अंतरिम कर्तव्यपालन के लिए नियुक्त करेंगे।

question:
Apply the Local Government: Municipal Systems Act 32 of 2000 as enacted in the cited Gazette. Assume that other statutory requirements are satisfied unless specified.

A municipal councillor exercises a delegated power affecting a resident’s rights. The resident gives timely written appeal notice and reasons to the municipal manager. The council has exactly 15 councillors. Who is the appeal authority under section 62?

Answer only A, B, C or D.

choices.A: The executive mayor, as in an appeal from a decision of the municipal manager.
choices.B: The municipal manager, because that is where the appeal notice is lodged.
choices.C: The whole municipal council because it does not have more than 15 councillors.
choices.D: A council-appointed committee of councillors who took no part in the original decision.

question:
Apply the Public Audit Act 25 of 2004 in the cited consolidation. Assume that other statutory requirements are satisfied unless specified.

For an audit covered by section 11, the draft includes financial statements and legislative compliance findings. It omits reported performance against predetermined objectives and an assessment of whether resources were used efficiently. Which omission necessarily violates section 20's subject list?

Answer only A, B, C or D.

choices.A: Both omissions are necessarily violations because every matter in sections 20(2) and (3) is mandatory.
choices.B: Omitting efficiency; reported performance is always optional.
choices.C: Reported performance is mandatory; the efficiency assessment is discretionary.
choices.D: Neither, because the section requires only that the document bear the name audit report.

question:
Apply the cited text of the Promotion of Access to Information Act 2 of 2000 in the pinned Department of Justice consolidation. Assume no other statutory ground or procedure applies unless stated.

A public record falls solely within the mandatory revenue information protection in section 35(1), and the requester's own information exception does not apply. The requester invokes section 46 as though it lists every refusal ground. Is section 35 covered by that override?

Answer only A, B, C or D.

choices.A: No. Section 35 is not among the listed grounds that section 46 overrides.
choices.B: Yes. Every revenue record is deemed a commercial-interest record and therefore always covered by the override.
choices.C: No. Section 46 concerns private bodies exclusively and cannot override any ground for a public record.
choices.D: Yes. The override applies to every ground in the public-record refusal chapter without exception.

question:
Use only the archived Parliament-hosted constitutional consolidation listing amendments through 2012. This is a fixed-edition textual question, not a claim about later policy or legislation.

An apparent conflict arises between national legislation and a provincial constitution rather than an ordinary provincial statute. A lawyer argues that section 150’s preference for a reasonable conflict-avoiding interpretation therefore cannot apply. Which scope does section 150 expressly cover?

Choose one answer, A, B, C or D.

choices.A: Only national legislation–provincial constitution conflicts, excluding ordinary statutes.
choices.B: Only national–provincial legislation conflicts, excluding provincial constitutional texts.
choices.C: Neither category unless the national statute expressly authorises a conflict-avoiding reading.
choices.D: Both national–provincial legislation and national legislation–provincial constitution conflicts.

question:
Apply the Intergovernmental Relations Framework Act 13 of 2005 as enacted in Government Gazette No. 27898 of 15 August 2005. Assume no other law changes the effect of the cited provisions.

Two Minmecs existed when the Act took effect. X had been established by an Act of Parliament. Y had been created by administrative practice without another Act. Which is deemed established under section 9(1)?

Answer only A, B, C or D.

choices.A: Y only.
choices.B: Neither X nor Y.
choices.C: Both X and Y.
choices.D: X only.

question: Apply only the South African Constitution in the archived parliamentary consolidation through the Seventeenth Amendment. Treat the stated facts as exhaustive. The Judicial Service Commission considers a policy recommendation to national government about court administration, without considering any judge’s appointment. Should the members designated by the National Assembly and Council participate in that sitting?

choices.A: Yes. Legislative designees must participate in every Commission matter without exception.
choices.B: Only the Council designees must be absent; Assembly designees must remain.
choices.C: Only the Assembly designees must be absent; Council designees must remain.
choices.D: No. For matters other than appointment of a judge, the Commission sits without the members designated under section 178(1)(h) and (i).

question: Apply section 47 of the Intergovernmental Relations Framework Act 13 of 2005 in the official fixed snapshot supplied for this task. The Minister proposes Gazette guidelines concerning implementation protocols and monitoring indicators. They comply with the Act and differentiate requirements by functional area, type of intergovernmental structure, and objectively determinable municipal population bands. Which assessment best fits the express power?

choices.A: The differentiation exceeds the power because municipalities may be distinguished only by category, type or budgetary size.
choices.B: The differentiation is authorised because the section permits those subject matters and all three proposed bases of differentiation.
choices.C: The differentiation is authorised only if implementation protocols and monitoring indicators are placed in separate Acts of Parliament.
choices.D: The differentiation exceeds the power because functional areas may differ but types of intergovernmental structures must receive uniform treatment.

question: Apply South Africa’s Intergovernmental Relations Framework Act 13 of 2005, as enacted in 2005. Two national intergovernmental forums established under section 9 identify a problem involving both of their sectors. A joint meeting is necessary to consult on the problem. They wish to record a common position using agreed procedures. Which course is supported by the Act?

choices.A: They may meet jointly and exercise executive decision-making power over the problem because its intersectoral character expands their ordinary institutional powers.
choices.B: They must establish an interprovincial forum before meeting jointly, and that new body may issue the executive decision resolving the problem.
choices.C: They may meet jointly only after becoming one permanent forum, although the resulting structure must refrain from adopting any common recommendation.
choices.D: They may meet jointly to discuss and consult, and may adopt a resolution or recommendation without becoming an executive decision-making body.

question: Under South Africa’s Public Audit Act 25 of 2004, in the AGSA consolidation updated through 29 March 2019, the Deputy Auditor-General submits the annual financial statements to the external auditor exactly two months after financial year-end. The external auditor receives them that day and uses the full statutory period to submit the audit report. No other delay occurs. Which timetable correctly coordinates the external audit report and the Auditor-General’s completed annual submission?

choices.A: The external report is due two months after year-end, and the completed annual package is due six months after the external report.
choices.B: The external report is due four months after year-end, and the completed annual package remains due six months after year-end.
choices.C: The external report is due four months after receipt of the statements, and the completed annual package is due six months after year-end.
choices.D: The external report is due four months after year-end, and the completed annual package is due six months after receipt of that report.

question: Under South Africa's Public Audit Act 25 of 2004, in the AGSA consolidation updated through Gazette No. 42338 of 29 March 2019, the Auditor-General receives a complaint requesting an appropriate special audit of an institution within section 4(1) or (3). The engagement would preserve independence. No separate conclusion that the audit is in the public interest has been reached. Which statement correctly describes initiation and implementation?

choices.A: The complaint supplies an alternative statutory trigger; the Auditor-General may conduct the special audit and designate an authorised auditor, with Part 1 applying contextually.
choices.B: The complaint permits preparatory work, but the special audit cannot begin until a separate public-interest conclusion supplies an additional statutory trigger.
choices.C: The complaint obliges the Auditor-General to carry out the special audit personally, without discretion to designate an authorised auditor.
choices.D: The complaint permits designation of an authorised auditor, but a special audit is exempt from Part 1 because it is not an ordinary audit.

question: Apply South Africa's Public Audit Act 25 of 2004, AGSA consolidation through 29 March 2019. Two different auditees each have an audit committee. One audit is conducted by an authorised auditor; the other by an auditor appointed under section 25(1)(b). Both committees propose notifying their auditor only of meetings about final financial statements and permitting attendance only at the auditor's own expense. Which assessment follows from the express committee provisions?

choices.A: Both proposals are permissible because notice and auditee-funded participation are confined to meetings considering the final financial statements.
choices.B: Both auditors must receive notice of every committee meeting and may attend and participate at the expense of their respective auditees.
choices.C: Both auditors must receive every notice, but only the authorised auditor may attend and participate at the auditee's expense.
choices.D: The authorised auditor must receive every notice and may participate at auditee expense, while the appointed auditor has only a consultation entitlement.

question: Apply South Africa’s Public Audit Act 25 of 2004, official consolidation updated through 29 March 2019. Compare two otherwise identical cases of unpaid audit fees: in one the auditee is a municipal entity; in the other it is a provincial department. Both invoices are 40 days old, both auditees fall within mandatory Auditor-General auditing, and the appropriate treasury has consulted the Auditor-General about paying the fees from an identified budget vote. What difference does the change of auditee create?

choices.A: The budget-vote payment mechanism becomes available only for the provincial department, while the municipal entity must rely exclusively on legal recovery proceedings.
choices.B: The provincial department becomes exempt from mandatory Auditor-General auditing, while the municipal entity remains subject to both auditing and budget-vote payment.
choices.C: The specified budget-vote payment mechanism is available for the municipal entity but excludes the provincial department; mandatory auditing and the 30-day settlement requirement apply to both.
choices.D: The budget-vote payment mechanism remains available for both, but the provincial department’s invoice is excluded from the 30-day settlement requirement.

question: Apply South Africa's Local Government: Municipal Systems Act 32 of 2000, using sections 41 and 81 as enacted on 20 November 2000. A section 76(b) provider will operate until its agreement expires in six months. The service is an integrated-development priority, and the section 81 takeover requirement is applicable on expiry. The municipality proposes stopping agreement-performance monitoring immediately because it will take over the service and all assets at expiry. Which course follows the supplied provisions?

choices.A: Replace agreement-performance monitoring with asset-inventory checks alone and take over the service and all assets when the agreement expires.
choices.B: Stop agreement-performance monitoring now and take over the service and all assets when the agreement expires.
choices.C: Continue agreement-performance monitoring during the remaining term and take over operations alone, leaving all assets outside the takeover.
choices.D: Continue agreement-performance monitoring during the remaining term and take over the service, including all assets, when the agreement expires.

question: Under South Africa's Local Government: Municipal Systems Act 32 of 2000 (fixed official archived 2000 edition, without later amendments), a council proposes delegating an immovable-property expropriation decision to its chief financial officer. A council policy framework exists. Which single replacement proposal falls within section 60's permitted recipient and framework requirements?

choices.A: Retain the expropriation delegation to the chief financial officer after making the council's policy framework more detailed.
choices.B: Delegate an investment decision to the chief financial officer within a policy framework determined by the Minister of Finance.
choices.C: Retain the expropriation delegation to the chief financial officer after obtaining a supporting recommendation from the executive mayor.
choices.D: Delegate the expropriation decision to the municipal manager within the same council-determined policy framework.

question: Under South Africa’s Promotion of Access to Information Act 2 of 2000 (29 May 2025 official consolidation), a third party learns independently of a public-body access request and never receives formal section 47 notification. Twenty-four days after learning of it, but before the officer decides, the third party makes oral representations explaining why access should be refused. Which treatment is supported by sections 48 and 49?

choices.A: Consider the representations with due regard and notify the third party of the decision; the formal-notification 21-day limit does not govern this route.
choices.B: Consider the representations informally, but omit decision notification because the third party was never formally notified of the request.
choices.C: Reject the representations as late because every third party has 21 days from any form of knowledge to intervene.
choices.D: Consider the representations only if rewritten, and give notice only if the third party subsequently consents to disclosure.

question: Under South Africa's Promotion of Access to Information Act 2 of 2000, in the Department of Justice consolidation dated 29 May 2025, an officer has already validly extended a public-body request's original 30-day period once by a further 30 days. Before that extension expires, the requester consents in writing to another 20 days. The officer grants the second extension and claims in a section 78 court application that it complies with section 26(1). Which conclusion correctly combines the extension limit and the litigation burden?

choices.A: The second extension is authorized because each consent permits up to 30 additional days, and the requester must disprove compliance.
choices.B: The second extension exceeds the once-only power unless several operational grounds coexist, and the requester bears the burden of proving their absence.
choices.C: The second extension is authorized because written consent removes the once-only restriction, and the officer must establish that the consent is genuine.
choices.D: The second extension exceeds the once-only power despite written consent, and the party claiming compliance bears the burden of establishing it.

question: Under South Africa's Promotion of Access to Information Act 2 of 2000, apply the fixed v1.3 snapshot of section 11 and the Department of Justice consolidation dated 29 May 2025 of section 35. An individual requests a SARS revenue-enforcement record containing only personal information about that individual. The individual argues that section 35's exception necessarily establishes an entitlement under section 11(1). Which conclusion is supported by these particular provisions?

choices.A: Section 35 cannot justify refusal of that information, but section 11(2) excludes this personal-information request from the request contemplated in section 11(1).
choices.B: Section 11(2) removes the personal-information request from subsection (1), so section 35(1) necessarily requires refusal despite its exception.
choices.C: Section 35 cannot justify refusal of that information, so section 11(1) necessarily requires disclosure without any further statutory inquiry.
choices.D: Section 35's exception applies only to representatives, so an individual requesting their own revenue information remains subject to mandatory refusal.

question: Apply South Africa's Promotion of Access to Information Act 2 of 2000 in the fixed v1.3 official snapshot. A third party brings a valid internal appeal. The requester receives notice under section 76(7) and then makes written representations under section 76(9). No other third party requires notice under section 76(1). Which combination correctly states the relevant authority's decision deadline and immediate notification duties under section 77?

choices.A: Decide within five working days after the written representations, immediately notify the appellant and requester, and give adequate statutory reasons excluding references to the record's content.
choices.B: Decide within 30 days after the written representations, immediately notify the appellant and requester, and give adequate statutory reasons excluding references to the record's content.
choices.C: Decide within five working days after the written representations, immediately notify only the appellant, and include record excerpts to explain the reasons.
choices.D: Decide within 30 days after the original appeal, immediately notify only the requester, and omit reasons whenever the record contains protected information.

question: Apply South Africa's PAJA, using section 7 in the PAJA-v13 fixed archive and section 10 in the official consolidation through Act 8 of 2017. Two instruments are being assessed solely for the identity of their maker and their approval requirements: judicial-review procedural rules under section 7(3), and regulations concerning protocols for drafting rules and standards under section 10(2)(b). Neither affects the public service or may cause State expenditure. Which allocation is correct before Gazette publication?

choices.A: The Rules Board makes judicial-review rules subject to ministerial approval, and the Minister makes drafting-protocol regulations; both instruments need only be submitted to Parliament.
choices.B: The Minister makes both instruments; Parliament approves the judicial-review rules, while the drafting-protocol regulations need only be submitted to Parliament.
choices.C: The Rules Board makes both instruments subject to ministerial approval; Parliament must approve the drafting protocols but need only receive the judicial-review rules.
choices.D: The Rules Board makes judicial-review rules subject to ministerial approval, and the Minister makes drafting-protocol regulations; Parliament must approve both instruments.

question: Apply South Africa's Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (Department of Justice consolidation through Act 8 of 2017, with the allocation note dated 11 October 2024). A suitably qualified panel conducts a public inquiry, including a public hearing and all prescribed procedures. It recommends administrative action, but the administrator has not yet adopted the recommendation. The panel proposes giving only oral findings because no action has yet been taken. No departure applies. Which response follows section 4?

choices.A: The panel must compile a written report with reasons for recommended action, followed as soon as possible by the required public dissemination.
choices.B: A written report is required now, but reasons may be omitted because the panel only recommended action.
choices.C: The panel must issue the final administrative decision because only a decision-maker can complete an inquiry report.
choices.D: Oral findings suffice until the administrator acts, after which the administrator alone must prepare the inquiry report.

question: Apply section 5 of South Africa's Promotion of Administrative Justice Act in the fixed official v1.3 snapshot. Administrator One is empowered by an empowering provision to use a fair procedure differing from section 5(2), and follows it. Administrator Two instead departs from furnishing adequate reasons under section 5(4); its departure is stipulated to be reasonable and justifiable after considering all relevant factors, but it plans to notify the requester a month later. Which assessment is correct?

choices.A: The first may follow its authorised procedure, while the second need notify only if the requester later institutes judicial review.
choices.B: The first may follow its authorised fair procedure, while the second must inform the requester forthwith despite its justified departure.
choices.C: The first must additionally establish a justified departure, while the second may postpone notification because justification has been established.
choices.D: Both must obtain the Minister's permission because neither statutory route permits an administrator to alter the ordinary reasons procedure independently.

question: Apply South Africa's Constitution in Parliament's consolidation through 2012. The President authorises employment of the defence force to fulfil an international obligation. Parliament does not sit during the first seven days after employment begins. The appropriate oversight committee receives the reasons, deployment locations and number of people involved, but receives no expected deployment period. Officials propose giving that information only when Parliament returns. What does section 201 require in these circumstances?

choices.A: The committee must approve the operation's legality, while the expected period may be withheld until Parliament returns.
choices.B: The President must end the deployment after seven days because Parliament has not sat to receive the information.
choices.C: The President must provide the expected period to the committee as part of the full information required during Parliament's absence.
choices.D: The committee needs only reasons and locations, while personnel numbers and the expected period are reserved for Parliament.

question: Under the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996, in the archived parliamentary consolidation through 2012, a Premier is unavailable for National Council of Provinces business. The Premier designates a provincial legislator who is not a permanent delegate to occupy the Premier's special-delegate position, and separately designates an existing permanent delegate to head the delegation. Which assessment follows the constitutional composition and leadership rules?

choices.A: Both designations are permitted: the replacement may be a provincial legislator, while the head may be another member of the delegation.
choices.B: Both designations fail because the unavailable Premier must be replaced by a permanent delegate who also heads the delegation.
choices.C: The leadership designation is valid, but the replacement must be selected by the provincial legislature without a Premier's designation.
choices.D: The replacement designation is valid, but the delegation must be headed by the legislator occupying the Premier's position.

question: Under the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996, in the archived parliamentary consolidation through 2012, exceptional circumstances warrant dissolving a Municipal Council for failure to fulfil an executive obligation under the ordinary intervention provision. The province immediately sends written notices to all required recipients. The National Council of Provinces receives its notice on Monday, and the responsible Cabinet member sets the dissolution aside ten days later. Which result follows?

choices.A: The dissolution took effect when the province issued its notice, so the Cabinet member's later decision cannot prevent its operation.
choices.B: The dissolution takes effect after 14 days unless both the Cabinet member and the National Council of Provinces set it aside.
choices.C: The dissolution does not take effect because the Cabinet member set it aside before the 14-day period following Council receipt expired.
choices.D: The dissolution remains pending for 180 days because the National Council of Provinces must affirmatively approve every dissolution.

question: Apply South Africa’s Constitution of 1996, in the archived parliamentary consolidation through 2012. A Deputy Minister was validly appointed from outside the National Assembly. She wishes personally to introduce an ordinary Bill in the Assembly. The Bill is neither a money Bill nor a Bill providing for legislation envisaged in section 214. She also proposes personally introducing it in the National Council of Provinces, although she is not a Council member. Which assessment is correct?

choices.A: She may introduce it in the Assembly, but her Deputy Ministerial office does not authorise personal introduction in the Council.
choices.B: She may introduce it in either House because Deputy Ministers have an independent power to choose the originating House.
choices.C: She may introduce it in the Council, but only an Assembly member may personally introduce it in the Assembly.
choices.D: She may introduce it in neither House because a Deputy Minister must also be an Assembly member to introduce legislation.

question: Under South Africa’s Constitution of 1996, archived parliamentary consolidation through 2012, a proposed constitutional amendment concerns neither section 1 nor Chapter 2. It does not affect the National Council of Provinces, alter provincial boundaries, powers, functions or institutions, or amend a specifically provincial provision. Public and provincial written comments are received. Which procedural package correctly distinguishes consultation from the Council’s role in passing this amendment?

choices.A: Publish particulars and seek provincial views at least 30 days before introduction; obtain six provincial votes and submit written comments to both presiding officers.
choices.B: Publish particulars and seek provincial views at least 30 days before introduction; dispense with Council debate and send written comments only to the Speaker.
choices.C: Publish particulars and seek provincial views at least 30 days before introduction; replace Council debate with submission of written comments to its Chairperson.
choices.D: Publish particulars, seek provincial views and submit particulars for Council debate at least 30 days before introduction; submit received written comments to the Speaker upon introduction.

question: Apply the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996, in the archived parliamentary consolidation through 2012. Permanent delegate Lerato loses the confidence of her provincial legislature but remains a member of her nominating party. That party recalls her ten days later. Permanent delegate Yusuf resigns from his nominating party, which does not recall him at any point during those ten days. Neither delegate meets any other loss-of-office ground, and neither term otherwise expires. Which account is correct?

choices.A: Lerato loses office when the recall follows her loss of legislative confidence, while Yusuf retains office during the stated period because he is not recalled.
choices.B: Lerato retains office even after recall because she remains a party member, while Yusuf loses office immediately upon resigning from his nominating party.
choices.C: Lerato loses office immediately upon losing legislative confidence, while Yusuf loses office immediately upon resigning from his nominating party.
choices.D: Lerato loses office immediately upon losing legislative confidence, while Yusuf retains office because resignation must also be accompanied by party recall.

question: Apply South Africa’s Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996, in the archived parliamentary consolidation through 2012. A Bill envisaged in section 42(6) originated in the National Assembly. After mediation, a new version is approved by the National Council of Provinces. Of the Assembly’s 400 members, 200 support that version, 150 oppose it and 50 abstain. A Cabinet member who is not an Assembly member also purports to vote in favour. What follows?

choices.A: The Cabinet member supplies the necessary additional vote, so the mediated version must be submitted to the President for assent.
choices.B: The mediated version fails; the Cabinet vote cannot count, and the Assembly may revive its original Bill with at least 267 supporting members.
choices.C: The mediated version fails, but the Assembly may revive that version with 201 supporting members because the Council has already approved it.
choices.D: The mediated version passes because its 200 supporting members constitute a majority of the Assembly members who voted for or against it.

question: Apply South Africa’s Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996, in the archived parliamentary consolidation through 2012. The National Assembly passes an ordinary non-money Schedule 4 Bill. The National Council of Provinces passes an amended version, which the Assembly refuses to pass. Following referral, the Mediation Committee agrees on precisely the Council’s amended version. What is the required route from that agreement to presidential assent?

choices.A: The committee’s agreement itself authorises submission to the President because the Council previously passed the identical amended text.
choices.B: The agreed text must return to the Assembly, and Assembly passage permits submission without a further Council vote.
choices.C: The agreed text must return to both Houses, and each must approve it anew before it can be submitted to the President.
choices.D: The agreed text must return only to the Council, whose renewed approval permits submission without another Assembly decision.

question: Apply South Africa’s Constitution, 1996, in the archived parliamentary consolidation through the Seventeenth Amendment (2012). A province commits a serious material breach of national treasury norms. The national treasury immediately stops a transfer due to the province under section 214(1)(b) for 90 days. The Auditor-General reports, and the province answers the allegations before a committee. Parliament completes the prescribed approval process on day 31 after the treasury’s decision. What follows?

choices.A: The stoppage remains effective for 30 days, with only the period preceding parliamentary approval becoming invalid.
choices.B: The stoppage becomes effective only on day 31 because parliamentary approval is required before enforcement begins.
choices.C: The stoppage remains effective because Parliament approved it before the authorised 90-day period expired.
choices.D: The stoppage lapses retrospectively because the parliamentary approval process was completed after the constitutional deadline.

question: Apply South Africa’s Constitution, 1996, in the archived parliamentary consolidation through the Seventeenth Amendment (2012). For the Commission governed by section 221, national legislation creates candidate lists for the three appointments associated with Premiers and the two associated with organised local government. The legislation excludes both groups from compiling their respective lists. The President later consults both groups before selecting appropriately expert candidates from those lists. Which conclusion follows?

choices.A: The arrangements satisfy the Constitution because consultation before selection replaces any requirement to participate in list compilation.
choices.B: The arrangements remain deficient because the Premiers and organised local government must make the appointments themselves.
choices.C: The arrangements remain deficient because participation in compiling the respective lists is required in addition to consultation before selection.
choices.D: The arrangements satisfy the Constitution because appropriate expertise dispenses with the prescribed participation and consultation arrangements.

question: Apply South Africa’s Constitution in the archived parliamentary consolidation through the Seventeenth Amendment of 2012. The Council’s Chairperson and five-year Deputy Chairperson are permanent delegates whose delegate terms expire after two years. The other Deputy Chairperson completes a one-year term representing Province P. A permanent delegate from Province P is proposed as the immediate successor to that annual deputy. Which treatment follows the constitutional tenure rules?

choices.A: The two longer offices continue for five years; the annual successor may represent Province P because the successor is permanent.
choices.B: The two longer offices end when their delegate terms expire; the annual successor must represent another province.
choices.C: The two longer offices end when their delegate terms expire; the annual successor may represent Province P if newly elected.
choices.D: The two longer offices continue for five years; the annual successor must represent another province.

question: Apply South Africa’s Constitution in the archived parliamentary consolidation through the Seventeenth Amendment of 2012. The Council jointly designates four permanent delegates to the Judicial Service Commission with six provinces supporting. One later vacates the Commission place. The Council proposes leaving the other three in office and designating only one replacement with five provinces supporting. Which constitutional treatment is correct?

choices.A: The original designation was valid; the vacancy ends the group’s terms, requiring a joint designation supported by at least six provinces.
choices.B: The original designation was valid; the remaining three continue and one replacement may be designated by five provinces.
choices.C: The original designation required seven provinces; correcting that vote alone allows the three remaining members to continue.
choices.D: The original designation was valid; only the vacant place needs replacement, but six provinces must support that replacement.

question: Apply the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996, in the archived parliamentary consolidation through 2012. Revenue has been allocated through a province to municipalities in that province in terms of section 214(1). National legislation validly establishes a framework requiring monthly payment instalments. The provincial appropriation Act contains no appropriation for this allocation. Provincial officials argue both that payment must await an appropriation and that direct-charge status would free payments from the national framework. Which assessment follows?

choices.A: The allocation requires a provincial appropriation before payment, although the valid national framework will govern payments once that appropriation exists.
choices.B: The allocation requires a provincial appropriation before payment, and the province may disregard the national framework when deciding payment arrangements.
choices.C: The allocation is a constitutional direct charge requiring no separate appropriation, and payment must comply with the valid national framework.
choices.D: The allocation is a constitutional direct charge requiring no separate appropriation, and that status removes national authority over payment arrangements.

question: Under South Africa's Constitution, in Parliament's archived consolidation through 2012, the National Assembly has 400 members. At a sitting attended by 180 members, including the presiding Deputy Speaker, an ordinary policy motion receives 100 votes for and 79 against. A resolution removing the Speaker then receives the same votes with the same attendance. Neither question attracts another special constitutional voting rule. What is the correct assessment?

choices.A: The policy motion passes, but the removal resolution lacks the specifically required attendance of a majority of Assembly members.
choices.B: Neither resolution is valid because a majority of the Assembly's entire membership must attend every vote on a resolution.
choices.C: The removal resolution passes, but the policy motion requires supporting votes from a majority of the Assembly's entire membership.
choices.D: Both resolutions are valid because attendance exceeds one third of the membership and each receives a majority of votes cast.

question: Under South Africa's Constitution, in Parliament's archived consolidation through 2012, a company seeks determination of a contractual dispute resolvable by applying law. The nature of the hearing right and of the company supports the company's entitlement to that right. The proposed forum is otherwise appropriate and promises a fair public hearing, but it is controlled by the opposing party and that party's director will decide the dispute. Which assessment follows?

choices.A: The company can hold the right, but only a court can ever determine a contractual dispute within the hearing provision.
choices.B: The company can hold the right on the stated basis, and the proposed forum fails the independent-and-impartial requirement despite its public hearing.
choices.C: The company can hold the right, and the proposed forum satisfies it because fair public proceedings dispense with institutional independence.
choices.D: The company cannot invoke the hearing right because juristic persons are excluded from rights concerned with adjudication.

question: Under the South African Constitution, 1996, in the archived parliamentary consolidation through 2012, an amendment changes an administrative responsibility of the National Council of Provinces and therefore affects the Council. It alters no provincial boundaries, powers, functions or institutions, deals with no specifically provincial matter, and concerns no particular province or group of provinces. It changes neither section 1, section 74(1), nor Chapter 2. The Assembly passes it with 70 per cent support. Which further passage requirement applies?

choices.A: The Council must pass it with support from at least six provinces because affecting the Council independently triggers its passage requirement.
choices.B: No Council passage is required because the amendment does not alter provincial powers or deal specifically with a provincial matter.
choices.C: Every provincial legislature must approve it because any amendment affecting the Council necessarily concerns each province individually.
choices.D: The Assembly must first increase its support to 75 per cent because amendments affecting the Council receive the same protection as section 1.

question: Under South Africa's Intergovernmental Relations Framework Act 13 of 2005 (2005 as-enacted text), a provincial government is developing legislation affecting the local sphere throughout the province and imposing a unique restructuring burden on one identified municipality. It has considered national priorities and local community interests. Which consultation plan satisfies the recipient requirements in section 36?

choices.A: Consult either the local sphere generally or the uniquely burdened municipality, choosing whichever process best captures the financial effects.
choices.B: Consult the local sphere generally, while treating the uniquely burdened municipality's participation as optional if general consultation is extensive.
choices.C: Consult the local sphere in the province and the specifically affected municipality, ensuring that both statutory recipient requirements are met.
choices.D: Consult the uniquely burdened municipality alone, because its particular exposure makes wider local-sphere consultation unnecessary.

question:
Terapkan hanya pasal yang disebut dari Undang-Undang Nomor 14 Tahun 2008 tentang Keterbukaan Informasi Publik, naskah asli diundangkan 30 April 2008 beserta penjelasan resmi yang diarsipkan. Soal menguji aturan undang-undang pendamping hak konstitusional atas informasi, bukan seluruh perkembangan peraturan pelaksana. Anggap syarat lain yang tidak dipersoalkan telah dipenuhi; jangan menambahkan pengecualian atau fakta yang tidak diberikan. Pasal 33 yang telah mendapat putusan pengujian tidak digunakan.

Sebuah putusan Komisi menyangkut informasi dikecualikan. Komentar menyatakan46(3) memerintahkan setiap putusan tanpa kecuali diucapkan terbuka. Apa kualifikasi yang terdapat dalam ayat itu?

Pilih satu jawaban: A, B, C, atau D.

choices.A: Kaidah pengucapan terbuka mengecualikan putusan yang menyangkut informasi dikecualikan.
choices.B: Pengucapan hanya dapat ditutup atas persetujuan seluruh pihak, tanpa kategori khusus.
choices.C: Tidak ada pengecualian apapun pada pengucapan terbuka.
choices.D: Semua putusan Komisi harus selalu dirahasiakan walau informasinya terbuka.

question: Terapkan ketentuan UU 1 Tahun 2004 dalam naskah resmi yang diarsipkan bersama v1.3, tanpa perubahan sesudah naskah tersebut. Kasus A menuntut ganti kerugian terhadap bendahara. Kasus B menuntut ganti kerugian terhadap pegawai negeri bukan bendahara. Apa perbedaan penetapan yang disebut kedua pasal?

choices.A: A ditetapkan BPK; B ditetapkan menteri atau pimpinan lembaga atau kepala daerah sesuai kategori yang disebut.
choices.B: A ditetapkan hanya oleh bank sentral, sedangkan B oleh Presiden negara lain.
choices.C: B tidak pernah dapat dikenai ganti kerugian karena bukan bendahara.
choices.D: A dan B selalu ditetapkan sendiri oleh pegawai yang dikenai tuntutan.

question: Berdasarkan UUD Negara Republik Indonesia Tahun 1945, naskah arsip DPR setelah Perubahan Keempat (2002), sebelum Presiden memangku jabatan, MPR tidak dapat mengadakan sidang tetapi DPR dapat bersidang. Panitia menolak pengucapan sumpah di hadapan DPR karena MPR berwenang melantik Presiden, lalu mengusulkan pengucapan sumpah di hadapan pimpinan MPR dengan saksi pimpinan MA. Koreksi mana yang tepat khusus mengenai pengucapan sumpah?

choices.A: Sumpah dapat diucapkan di hadapan pimpinan MA saja karena ketidakmampuan MPR bersidang memindahkan kewenangan pengambilan sumpah kepadanya.
choices.B: Sumpah harus menunggu sidang MPR karena kewenangan pelantikan meniadakan kemungkinan pengucapan sumpah di hadapan DPR.
choices.C: Sumpah dapat diucapkan di hadapan DPR yang dapat bersidang; kewenangan pelantikan MPR tidak menghapus pilihan tempat sumpah tersebut.
choices.D: Sumpah harus diucapkan di hadapan pimpinan MPR karena ketidakmampuan MPR bersidang selalu menutup jalur pengucapan di hadapan DPR.

question: Berdasarkan UU No. 37 Tahun 2008 tentang Ombudsman Republik Indonesia (edisi resmi 7 Oktober 2008), Ombudsman memperoleh informasi pelayanan publik yang belum menjadi Laporan. Seorang anggotanya diminta turut memeriksa informasi itu. Telah diketahui bahwa informasi tersebut dapat menimbulkan konflik kepentingan dengan dirinya, meskipun konflik nyata belum terbukti dan belum ada kesimpulan pemeriksaan. Apa akibat hukum yang tepat bagi keterlibatannya?

choices.A: Ia dilarang turut memeriksa karena larangan mencakup informasi yang dapat menimbulkan konflik kepentingan, tanpa menunggu konflik nyata.
choices.B: Ia boleh turut memeriksa sampai konflik kepentingan benar-benar terjadi karena kemungkinan konflik belum memenuhi ambang larangan.
choices.C: Ia boleh turut memeriksa sepanjang tidak menandatangani kesimpulan karena larangan hanya membatasi penetapan hasil pemeriksaan.
choices.D: Ia boleh turut memeriksa sampai informasi menjadi Laporan karena larangan konflik kepentingan hanya berlaku dalam pemeriksaan Laporan.

question: Dalam penerapan UU Nomor 37 Tahun 2008 tentang Ombudsman Republik Indonesia, edisi diundangkan 7 Oktober 2008, Ketua telah berhenti karena mengundurkan diri. Wakil Ketua menjalankan tugas dan wewenangnya. Pemeriksaan telah menemukan Maladministrasi dan menghasilkan Rekomendasi yang perlu ditandatangani serta disampaikan. Prosedur mana yang tepat?

choices.A: Wakil Ketua menandatangani dalam pelaksanaan kewenangan Ketua, lalu Rekomendasi disampaikan hanya kepada Terlapor dan atasannya dalam 14 hari.
choices.B: Meminta Presiden menandatangani Rekomendasi sebagai pejabat pemberhenti, kemudian menyampaikannya kepada ketiga penerima dalam 14 hari.
choices.C: Menunggu pemilihan Ketua baru sebelum Rekomendasi ditandatangani, kemudian menyampaikannya kepada ketiga penerima dalam 14 hari.
choices.D: Wakil Ketua menandatangani dalam pelaksanaan kewenangan Ketua, lalu Rekomendasi disampaikan kepada ketiga penerima dalam 14 hari sejak penandatanganan.

question: Berdasarkan UU 15 Tahun 2006 tentang BPK, edisi pengundangan 30 Oktober 2006, seorang anggota BPK merangkap jabatan direktur tanpa honorarium pada perusahaan swasta nasional yang tidak mengelola keuangan negara. Ia juga tetap menjadi anggota partai politik, tetapi tidak menduduki jabatan kepengurusan partai. Ia berpendapat kedua hubungan diperbolehkan karena tidak membebani keuangan negara dan tidak menghasilkan penghasilan tambahan. Penilaian mana yang sesuai dengan larangan bagi anggota BPK?

choices.A: Kedua hubungan diperbolehkan selama tidak menimbulkan beban keuangan negara, karena syarat itu berlaku bagi seluruh larangan hubungan kelembagaan anggota.
choices.B: Kedua hubungan terkena larangan: rangkap jabatan pada swasta nasional dan keanggotaan partai tidak bergantung pada honorarium atau jabatan kepengurusan.
choices.C: Hanya keanggotaan partai terkena larangan; jabatan direktur swasta diperbolehkan selama perusahaan tidak mengelola keuangan negara dan tidak membayar honorarium.
choices.D: Hanya rangkap jabatan direktur terkena larangan; keanggotaan partai diperbolehkan apabila anggota tidak menjadi pengurus dan tidak memperoleh penghasilan.

question: Terapkan UU Nomor 15 Tahun 2006 tentang BPK, edisi naskah resmi arsip 2006. Sebuah tim menyiapkan tiga materi pengaturan: tata cara DPR memilih Anggota BPK, tata cara Anggota BPK memilih Ketua dan Wakil Ketua, serta pembagian tugas dan wewenang antara Ketua, Wakil Ketua, dan anggota. Tim ingin menyerahkan seluruh materi kepada satu pembentuk peraturan. Pembagian instrumen manakah yang sesuai dengan undang-undang?

choices.A: Seluruh materi dituangkan dalam peraturan BPK karena pemilihan anggota, pemilihan pimpinan, dan pembagian tugas semuanya menyangkut organisasi BPK.
choices.B: Seluruh materi dituangkan dalam Peraturan Tata Tertib DPR karena pemilihan Anggota BPK merupakan tahap awal pembentukan lembaga dan pimpinannya.
choices.C: Pemilihan anggota dan pimpinan diatur dalam Peraturan Tata Tertib DPR; pembagian tugas dan wewenang pimpinan serta anggota diatur dalam peraturan BPK.
choices.D: Pemilihan anggota diatur dalam Peraturan Tata Tertib DPR; pemilihan pimpinan serta pembagian tugas dan wewenang pimpinan dan anggota diatur dalam peraturan BPK.

question: Menurut UU 30 Tahun 2014 dalam naskah asli 17 Oktober 2014, pejabat penerbit menemukan kesalahan redaksional dalam keputusannya. Dengan alasan objektif dan memperhatikan AUPB, ia menetapkan perubahan pada hari kerja keempat sejak penemuan. Perubahan tidak merugikan warga yang ditunjuk. Ia ingin memberlakukan perubahan sejak tanggal keputusan lama karena kesalahannya hanya redaksional. Bagaimana pengaturan waktu yang tepat?

choices.A: Penetapan harus ditunda sampai hari kerja kelima, dan keputusan perubahan berlaku sejak tanggal kesalahan redaksional ditemukan.
choices.B: Penetapan harus dilakukan dalam lima hari kalender, dan keputusan perubahan berlaku sejak keputusan lama pertama kali disampaikan.
choices.C: Penetapan pada hari kerja keempat memenuhi tenggat, dan keputusan perubahan berlaku surut karena dasar perubahannya berupa kesalahan redaksional.
choices.D: Penetapan pada hari kerja keempat memenuhi tenggat, tetapi keputusan perubahan berlaku sejak keputusan perubahan itu ditetapkan.

question: Menurut UU Nomor 30 Tahun 2014 tentang Administrasi Pemerintahan, naskah asli 17 Oktober 2014, suatu badan diminta memberikan Bantuan Kedinasan berupa tenaga teknis. Pemberian bantuan akan memengaruhi kinerja badan pemberi, tetapi tidak menyangkut dokumen rahasia dan tidak dilarang peraturan. Semula bantuan diperlukan untuk kegiatan biasa. Sebelum badan memberikan respons, keadaan berubah sehingga bantuan yang sama diperlukan dalam keadaan darurat. Bagaimana perubahan itu memengaruhi kewajibannya?

choices.A: Dalam keadaan biasa badan dapat menolak dengan alasan tertulis, tetapi setelah bantuan diperlukan dalam keadaan darurat badan wajib memberikannya meskipun kinerjanya terpengaruh.
choices.B: Dalam keadaan biasa badan wajib membantu, sedangkan dalam keadaan darurat badan dapat menolak dengan alasan tertulis karena gangguan terhadap kinerja menjadi lebih besar.
choices.C: Dalam kedua keadaan badan dapat menolak secara lisan karena alasan pengaruh terhadap kinerja sudah cukup tanpa memerlukan penjelasan tertulis kepada badan peminta.
choices.D: Dalam kedua keadaan badan dapat menolak dengan alasan tertulis karena pengaruh terhadap kinerja selalu mengesampingkan kebutuhan bantuan, termasuk dalam keadaan darurat.

question: Menurut UU 30 Tahun 2014 tentang Administrasi Pemerintahan, edisi arsip tetap v1.3 tanpa perubahan kemudian, suatu Keputusan diumumkan pada 3 Juni. Pengirim mencatat penerimaan pada 5 Juni, tetapi penerima mempunyai bukti penerimaan pada 7 Juni; pengirim tidak dapat membuktikan sebaliknya. Keputusan dibatalkan pada 12 Juni karena kesalahan prosedur. Sertifikat yang terbit sebagai akibat Keputusan masih dipegang penerima. Bagaimana daya mengikat dan kewajiban atas sertifikat tersebut?

choices.A: Keputusan mengikat sejak 7 Juni sampai pembatalan pada 12 Juni; penerima wajib mengembalikan sertifikat kepada badan yang menetapkan pembatalan.
choices.B: Keputusan mengikat sejak 7 Juni sampai pembatalan pada 12 Juni; penerima boleh menyimpan sertifikat karena diterbitkan sebelum pembatalan.
choices.C: Keputusan mengikat sejak 3 Juni sampai pembatalan pada 12 Juni; penerima wajib mengembalikan sertifikat kepada badan yang menetapkan pembatalan.
choices.D: Keputusan mengikat sejak 5 Juni sampai pembatalan pada 12 Juni; penerima wajib mengembalikan sertifikat kepada badan yang menetapkan pembatalan.

question: Menurut UU 30 Tahun 2014 tentang Administrasi Pemerintahan, edisi arsip tetap v1.3 tanpa perubahan kemudian, sebuah Keputusan mencantumkan masa berlaku mulai Jumat hingga Minggu pada pekan yang sama. Keputusan diumumkan Jumat, tetapi baru diterima pihak yang disebut di dalamnya pada Sabtu; penerimaan itu tidak disengketakan. Senin berikutnya hari kerja. Tidak ada ketentuan khusus mengenai batas yang tidak dapat diundurkan dan tidak ada pembatalan. Bagaimana daya mengikat dan batas akhirnya?

choices.A: Keputusan mengikat sejak Jumat karena sudah diumumkan kepada masyarakat; batas keberlakuannya tetap Minggu karena tidak ada perpanjangan tersendiri.
choices.B: Keputusan mengikat sejak Sabtu karena baru diterima saat itu; batas keberlakuannya tetap Minggu karena tanggal akhir sudah dicantumkan.
choices.C: Keputusan mengikat sejak Sabtu karena waktu penerimaannya berbeda dari pengumuman; batas keberlakuannya bergeser dari Minggu ke Senin berikutnya.
choices.D: Keputusan mengikat sejak Jumat karena tanggal mulai telah dicantumkan; batas keberlakuannya bergeser dari Minggu ke Senin berikutnya.

question: Menurut UU Nomor 25 Tahun 2009 dalam naskah resmi arsip 18 Juli 2009, seluruh fasilitas fisik sebuah unit pelayanan masih memadai. Namun, Pelaksana mengetahui bahwa jumlah Pelaksana tidak lagi memenuhi tuntutan kebutuhan standar pelayanan. Profil Pelaksana dalam sistem informasi sudah lengkap dan terbuka bagi masyarakat. Penyelenggara berpendapat bahwa tidak diperlukan laporan kebutuhan karena tidak ada kerusakan fasilitas dan informasi profil sudah diumumkan. Tindak lanjut mana yang tepat?

choices.A: Pelaksana tetap wajib melaporkan kondisi dan kebutuhan Pelaksana, lalu Penyelenggara menganalisisnya dan menyusun daftar kebutuhan yang mencakup Pelaksana.
choices.B: Laporan baru wajib dibuat apabila kekurangan Pelaksana juga menyebabkan fasilitas fisik rusak atau tidak sesuai peruntukannya.
choices.C: Pelaksana wajib membuat laporan, tetapi Penyelenggara hanya boleh memasukkan sarana dan prasarana fisik dalam daftar kebutuhan.
choices.D: Profil yang terbuka menggantikan laporan kebutuhan, sehingga Penyelenggara cukup memperbarui informasi tanpa menyusun daftar kebutuhan Pelaksana.

question: Menurut UU Nomor 25 Tahun 2009 tentang Pelayanan Publik, edisi arsip resmi tetap tahun 2009 tanpa perubahan sesudahnya, penyelenggara mengelola pengaduan langsung dari penerima pelayanan, tetapi menolak mengelola pengaduan yang berasal dari DPRD Kabupaten/Kota dengan alasan lembaga tersebut bukan penerima pelayanan. Telah ditetapkan terjadi pelanggaran kewajiban mengelola pengaduan dalam batas waktu tertentu. Tidak ada pelanggaran lain yang dinilai. Kewajiban dan sanksi mana yang sesuai?

choices.A: Pengaduan dari DPRD Kabupaten/Kota wajib dikelola, dan setiap penolakan langsung dikenai pembekuan izin tanpa memperhatikan kategori penyelenggaranya.
choices.B: Pengaduan dari DPRD Kabupaten/Kota termasuk yang wajib dikelola; pelanggaran tersebut dikenai penurunan gaji sebesar satu kali kenaikan gaji berkala paling lama satu tahun.
choices.C: Pengaduan dari DPRD Kabupaten/Kota wajib dikelola, tetapi pelanggarannya dikenai teguran tertulis dan pembebasan dari jabatan hanya setelah tiga bulan tidak dipenuhi.
choices.D: Pengaduan dari DPRD Kabupaten/Kota hanya wajib dikelola setelah diajukan kembali oleh penerima pelayanan; sebelum itu tidak terdapat pelanggaran kewajiban pengelolaan.

question: Menurut UU Nomor 25 Tahun 2009 tentang Pelayanan Publik, edisi arsip resmi tetap tahun 2009 tanpa perubahan sesudahnya, suatu kantor telah mengumumkan nama dan alamat penanggung jawab pengelola pengaduan serta sarana pengaduannya. Kantor juga sudah menyusun dan menetapkan maklumat kesanggupan memenuhi standar pelayanan, tetapi sengaja menyimpannya sebagai dokumen internal tanpa publikasi. Pejabat yang bertanggung jawab menyatakan pengumuman pengelola pengaduan sudah mencukupi. Apa penilaian yang tepat atas pelanggaran yang disebutkan?

choices.A: Maklumat cukup diberikan kepada pengadu yang memintanya, dan pelanggaran publikasi baru terjadi apabila kantor juga menyembunyikan identitas pengelola pengaduan.
choices.B: Pengumuman pengelola pengaduan sekaligus memenuhi publikasi maklumat, sehingga penyimpanan maklumat sebagai dokumen internal tidak merupakan pelanggaran.
choices.C: Maklumat tetap harus dipublikasikan, tetapi pelanggaran ini hanya dikenai teguran dan pembebasan setelah tiga bulan sebagaimana pengumuman pengelola pengaduan.
choices.D: Maklumat wajib dipublikasikan secara jelas dan luas secara tersendiri; pelanggaran Pasal 22 dikenai pembebasan dari jabatan menurut ketentuan sanksinya.

question: Menurut UU Nomor 25 Tahun 2009 tentang Pelayanan Publik, edisi arsip resmi tetap tahun 2009 tanpa perubahan sesudahnya, penyelenggara termasuk kategori Pasal 5 ayat (4) huruf c. Satu-satunya pelanggaran yang terbukti ialah tidak memeriksa pengaduan masyarakat mengenai pelayanannya, yaitu pelanggaran Pasal 47 ayat (1). Semua kewajiban yang disebut dalam Pasal 54 ayat (10) telah dipenuhi. Sebuah usulan meminta pembekuan izin semata-mata karena kategori penyelenggara tersebut. Bagaimana penerapan ketentuan sanksinya?

choices.A: Pelanggaran ini dikenai teguran tertulis dan pembebasan dari jabatan jika tetap tidak dipenuhi dalam tiga bulan; kategori penyelenggara saja tidak cukup untuk pembekuan.
choices.B: Pelanggaran ini langsung dikenai pembekuan izin, kemudian pencabutan setelah enam bulan, karena seluruh pelanggaran kategori tersebut tunduk pada sanksi perizinan.
choices.C: Pelanggaran ini dikenai penurunan gaji paling lama satu tahun, karena setiap kewajiban yang berkaitan dengan pengaduan memakai sanksi pengelolaan pengaduan.
choices.D: Pelanggaran ini dikenai pemberhentian tidak dengan hormat, karena penyelenggara berkategori khusus tidak memperoleh kesempatan memenuhi kewajiban setelah teguran.

question: Menurut UU Nomor 25 Tahun 2009 tentang Pelayanan Publik, edisi arsip resmi tetap tahun 2009 tanpa perubahan sesudahnya, temuan awal menyatakan Pelaksana tidak melakukan kewajiban Pasal 28 ayat (1) sehingga menimbulkan kerugian negara. Setelah koreksi fakta, satu-satunya kewajiban yang tidak dilakukan ternyata terdapat pada Pasal 28 ayat (4), dan hubungan sebab akibat dengan kerugian negara tetap terbukti. Tidak ada pelanggaran lain. Bagaimana perubahan konsekuensi menurut ketentuan yang tersedia?

choices.A: Sanksi tetap penurunan gaji paling lama satu tahun, sedangkan dasar denda tetap ada karena kedua pelanggaran berada dalam pasal yang sama.
choices.B: Sanksi berubah menjadi teguran dengan tenggat tiga bulan, sedangkan besaran denda berpindah dari pengadilan kepada pimpinan setelah koreksi fakta.
choices.C: Sanksi berubah dari penurunan gaji menjadi pembebasan dari jabatan, sedangkan dasar denda hilang karena Pasal 28 ayat (4) tidak tercakup.
choices.D: Sanksi berubah dari penurunan gaji menjadi pembebasan dari jabatan, sedangkan dasar denda tetap ada dan besarannya berdasarkan putusan pengadilan.

question: Menurut pertimbangan Putusan MK 22/PUU-XV/2017 yang diucapkan pada 13 Desember 2018, bayangkan tenggang tiga tahun yang diberikan kepada pembentuk undang-undang telah lewat dan tidak ada perubahan mengenai batas minimum usia perkawinan. Jangan menggunakan perubahan hukum yang sebenarnya terjadi kemudian. Penyelesaian mana yang dinyatakan Mahkamah untuk keadaan hipotetis itu?

choices.A: Batas minimum langsung menjadi 19 tahun bagi kedua jenis kelamin karena angka tersebut tercantum dalam petitum Pemohon.
choices.B: Batas usia lama tetap dipertahankan tanpa penyesuaian sampai pembentuk undang-undang menyepakati penggantinya.
choices.C: Batas minimum diharmonisasikan dengan usia anak dalam UU Perlindungan Anak dan diberlakukan sama bagi laki-laki serta perempuan.
choices.D: Batas minimum bagi perempuan diharmonisasikan dengan usia anak, sedangkan batas bagi laki-laki tetap diperlakukan secara terpisah.
